title: Delta-0 settings adjust (touch tap / mouse click / Enter / pad A) is unpinned AND a live no-op: palette + scale rows never change on the only touch path
evidence:
app/main.odin:796 (settings_click row tap):
				effect_settings_adjust(app.input.user, &app.input, i32(row), 0)
app/main.odin:762 (effect_settings_adjust):
		app.a11y.palette = rnd.Palette_Mode(cycle_palette(u8(app.a11y.palette), delta))
app/settings.odin:149-151:
cycle_scale :: proc(cur: u8, delta: i32) -> u8 {
	n := i32(UI_SCALE_COUNT)
	return u8((i32(cur) + delta + n) % n)
app/settings_test.odin:148:
	testing.expect(t, cycle_scale(0, 0) == 0, "a zero delta holds the step")
app/input/types.odin:177-179:
// the row (touch, via the app's ui-press): adjust the focused row. delta 0 =
// cycle/next; -1/+1 = step back/forward (palette + scale rows). The app
harness/parity.odin:199-200 (the ONLY hooks drive_parity ever wires):
	ictx.on_right_click = on_right_click
	ictx.on_ui_press = on_ui_press
detail: Every tap/click/Enter/A activate delivers delta 0; cycle_palette/cycle_scale(cur,0) return cur, so palette and scale rows are dead on touch, Enter, and pad A — contradicting the documented 'delta 0 = cycle/next'. No test wires on_settings_adjust; the unit test pins the no-op green.
recommended_fix: Normalize delta 0 to +1 for the cycle rows (settings_click and Enter/A), and add a test that wires on_settings_adjust and asserts a delta-0 activate advances palette + scale.

title: S-ownership gate (S collected only when sel_pipe < 0) has no test — no scenario drives S with a pipe selected
detail: The r1 B1 ownership resolution ships zero regression pin: no parity leg or unit test presses S with a selection. Dropping the sel_pipe<0 guard restores the same-frame dual-dispatch (Toggle_Settings + Set_Lane Standard) with the whole suite green.
recommended_fix: Add a parity leg: select a pipe, press S, assert no Toggle_Settings opened the panel AND Cmd_Set_Lane(Standard) fired exactly once.

title: Pause-on-open (effect_settings: Run -> Paused + ictx.mode sync) runs in no test
detail: The headline modal pause-on-open behaviour has no pin: parity never wires on_settings and asserts only panel_open/panel_row; settings_test covers file I/O only. A regression (panel opens, crises keep ticking) ships green.
recommended_fix: Add an app-level test (or wire on_settings in parity) asserting opening the panel during Run leaves mode Paused and closing keeps it Paused.

title: The claimed zero-guard pin is vacuous: hud_zero_scale test re-implements view_compute's guard instead of calling it
detail: The test duplicates the guard inline ('emulate view_compute's guard') and never calls view_compute, so deleting the real guard in view.odin leaves this test green — the claimed zero-guard pin does not bite the production code.
recommended_fix: Call rnd.view_compute on a zero-inited View in the test and assert ui_scale lands on 1.0, or drop the claim.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
detail: P0 ~67% (<100%): oracle poison/clean legs + byte-identical a11y goldens pinned, but the panel's core adjust path is dead on touch/Enter/A with zero coverage. P1 ~75% (<80%): persistence FULL (12 biting tests), hud rounding/identity FULL, banner clamp FULL; parity nav PARTIAL (no ±1 legs, no wrap, no S-ownership); pause-on-open NONE. Overall ~73% (<80%). All three FAIL clauses trip.
recommended_fix: Fix + pin the delta-0 activate contract (blocker 1), add the S-with-selection parity leg and a pause-on-open assert, and make the zero-guard test exercise view_compute — that lifts P0 to 100% and P1 past 90%.
